title: Dated forecasts: the career of "AI psychosis" and semantic physics to 2031
description: These are forecasts with stated check dates and falsifiers. Diagnostic Seigniorage II (#947, July 2026) forecasts the career of "AI psychosis" through nosological abstention, case reports, accusatory inversion, litigation, sanitized successor terms and bleach between 2027 and 2031, including one forecast against the archive's own holdings. Semantic Physics (#106, May 2026) forecasts the proliferation of exact-name frameworks, cross-system divergence and non-interoperable substrates through 2028, and the Platform Erosion Observatory (#1045) sets its own 2027 yield deadlines.
